subject.title: improve(diagnostics-otel): make agent-duration histograms usable beyond 10s

question: Should diagnostics-otel adopt this narrower run/harness/context bucket policy, the broader all-duration policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97098, or pause until exported metric defaults are settled?
rationale: Both branches alter existing exported metric aggregation and use different bucket scopes, so automation cannot safely choose the operator-facing default policy.

options.title: Resolve policy and require proof first
options.body: Choose the intended bucket scope, then require the selected branch to include redacted real OTel export proof before merge.

options.title: Accept this narrower policy
options.body: Maintain this PR's targeted run, harness, and context-token scope if maintainers want a minimal change to exported defaults.

options.title: Prefer the broader related policy
options.body: Use the related PR as the path only if maintainers want consistent duration advice across all OpenClaw millisecond histograms and that PR adds proof.

recommendation.title: Resolve policy and require proof first
recommendation.body: Choose the intended bucket scope, then require the selected branch to include redacted real OTel export proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns much of the diagnostics-otel metric history and introduced adjacent GenAI histogram advice and lifecycle telemetry.
